name: v29_model_revision_derivative_rescue
hypothesis: Model16 analyst-revision derivative has medium-term revision information; combining it with option-flow and only a small intraday term may avoid pure EPS/reversal crowding.
expression: 0.45 * rank(-1 * analyst_revision_rank_derivative) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_vol_10 - pcr_vol_180, 60), industry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_60_days, 60), industry)
notes: Mutates high-Fitness e7OzRv5p by replacing operating quality with option-flow/risk stabilizers.

name: v29_model_value_growth_revision
hypothesis: A blend of model value, growth, and revision acceleration may capture style improvement without directly using EPS yield or operating income.
notes: Pure model16 derivative blend; tests if model scores contain independent information.

name: v29_model_cashflow_certainty_low_risk
hypothesis: Cash-flow efficiency and earnings certainty should work better when idiosyncratic risk is low, while staying different from raw operating-income quality.
notes: Model quality/certainty test with risk relief instead of accounting fields.

name: v29_dilution_insider_without_reversal
hypothesis: Share-count contraction is strong but crowded when paired with reversal; using insider news, model valuation, and no close/open may preserve strength with lower correlation.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 252) / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_insider, 60), industry) + 0.30 * rank(relative_valuation_rank_derivative)
notes: Rescues xAxj3wPb/1Y7wXvZJ by removing close/open and buyback-quality anchors.

name: v29_deferred_revenue_growth_model_value
hypothesis: Deferred-revenue growth was a near-miss; model value and low risk may lift Fitness without returning to buyback/reversal parents.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * rank(relative_valuation_rank_derivative) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 90), industry)
notes: Rescues qMAj1o2O while avoiding sales_growth + close/open near-neighbor.

name: v29_rd_sales_growth_model_revision
hypothesis: R&D intensity plus sales growth was near the gate; model revision acceleration may separate true innovation momentum from stale growth.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(rd_expense / sales, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.30 * rank(-1 * analyst_revision_rank_derivative)

name: v29_writedown_legal_event_no_credit
hypothesis: Low writedown burden plus favorable legal news may identify reduced event overhang without the credit-capacity stabilizer that caused high correlation in v27.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_wdpq)), 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_legal, 60), industry) + 0.25 * rank(earnings_certainty_rank_derivative)
notes: Rescues mL8mrvq9/KPbNwEXg with legal/model stabilizers, no credit/buyback/reversal.

name: v29_stockcomp_debt_model_certainty
hypothesis: Stock-comp/debt event burden may become more orthogonal when paired with model earnings certainty rather than competitor graph or tax/prepaid accounting anchors.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(debt_extinguishment_gain_loss_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.35 * rank(earnings_certainty_rank_derivative)
notes: Rescues RRp7mKMg by replacing competitor graph with model certainty.

name: v29_event_rank_session_pressure_probe
hypothesis: Direct cross-sectional ranking of event-input news12 session fields may be valid where ts_rank failed, letting us test session pressure syntax cheaply.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(rank(nws12_mainz_sl), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(rank(nws12_mainz_volstddev), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(rank(-1 * abs(nws12_mainz_rangestddev)), industry)
notes: Syntax probe for event inputs; submit only if surprisingly strong and all checks pass.

name: v29_event_rank_vwap_acceptance_probe
hypothesis: Direct event-field ranks for relative performance and VWAP acceptance may capture news-session follow-through without time-series operators.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(rank(nws12_mainz_result_vs_index), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(rank(news_eod_vwap - news_main_vwap), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(rank(nws12_mainz_volstddev), industry)
notes: Second event-input syntax probe using ranks only.
